subject: Next steps for Redwood activation — DPA & PO requirements
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@newforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@newforge.com
Date: 2028-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps for Redwood activation — DPA & PO requirements

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NewForge is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to collect a few items before we can issue a PO and complete vendor activation: 

- Executed DPA (we typically require customer-facing DPA with a signing URL)
- Current SOC 2 report (or a read-only link and TOC)
- Full subprocessor list (with regions/data access notes)
- Vendor onboarding form (their standard PDF included below)
- PO instructions (how to address invoices, remit-to, contact for billing)

I've attached our onboarding checklist and the vendor form for completion (see attachments). Can you point me to where we can e-sign your DPA and send the SOC 2 link? Also please confirm a billing email and whether Redwood requires purchase orders for invoices or accepts Net 30 via invoice only.

If it's helpful, Contracts is copied on this thread — they prefer the DPA via DocuSign and a PO to match their SOW.

Thanks,

Emma Li
Vendor Ops — NewForge
emma.li@newforge.com
NewForge, Inc.

Attachments (referenced): NewForge_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, NewForge-Vendor-Form.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@newforge.com>, contracts@newforge.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-13T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Redwood activation — DPA & PO requirements

Emma —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers inline below, plus next steps to keep this moving: 

1) DPA: We maintain a standard customer DPA. I'll send a DocuSign link for signature within the hour. The file is also attached for your review (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf). If you have redlines, Contracts can propose them but we typically track minimal changes on security sections.

2) SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report (2028) is available here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2/2028-redwood-soc2-report.pdf
- We can provide a read-only link plus an index/TOC. If you need an NDA prior to access, let me know.

3) Subprocessors: Current list exported here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/security/subprocessors/2028_subprocessors.csv
- I'll attach a CSV snapshot (Redwood_Subprocessors.csv) to the e-mail for your vendor team.

4) Vendor form: Thanks for sending NewForge-Vendor-Form.pdf. Priyom — can Procurement fill the basic fields and return a completed copy?

5) PO / Billing: We accept POs. Preferred remit details:
- Invoices to billing@redwood.com
- PO reference on invoice required for expedited routing
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (unless otherwise negotiated)

Next steps (proposed):
- Marcus to route DPA link via DocuSign (today)
- Priyom to complete vendor form answers and return (EOD tomorrow)
- Contracts/Emma to review DPA and alert us to any redlines
- Once DPA complete, NewForge issues PO referencing NF-2028-03 / SOW-45

If that aligns, I can kick off the DocuSign flow now.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Sr. Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

On 2028-12-13 11:00, Marcus Lin wrote:
> 2) SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report (2028) is available here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2/2028-redwood-soc2-report.pdf

Thank you — Contracts here. A few items from our legal intake: 

- We expect a redline review of the DPA. Please initiate DocuSign but include an editable copy (we will propose a few narrow edits around subprocessors and audit rights).
- The vendor form has a couple of fields we need answered (tax ID, remit address, supplier classification). See attached NewForge-Vendor-Form.pdf with comments.
- For SOC 2 supporting evidence, could you provide the control mappings Appendix (or a TOC) and the auditor contact (for verification)?
- One question on subprocessors: do any subprocessors have access to raw prompt/response data? If yes, please identify which and whether access is limited to metadata only.

Finally, please confirm the PO recipient and that Redwood's invoices will include a remit-to address that matches your AP system (we can include PO on our end once the DPA is signed).

Contracts — NewForge
contracts@newforge.com

Attachment: NewForge-Vendor-Form.pdf (filled with comments)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-12-14T08:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for Redwood activation — DPA & PO requirements

Hi Contracts / Emma —

Thanks for the questions — Priyom from Procurement here. Quick operational responses and the files you requested are attached.

- Vendor form: completed required fields (tax ID, remit address, contact). See attached: completed_NewForge_Vendor_Form_filled.pdf (return copy).
- PO workflow: Issue PO to the address below and send invoice to billing@redwood.com with PO number in the subject line. Payment terms Net 30.
  Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1201 Redwood Ave, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107

- SOC 2 Appendix / auditor: Auditor: Clearwater Audit LLP — contact: audits@clearwateraudit.com. We've attached a SOC2_TOC.txt with the control mapping summary for your intake team.

- Subprocessor access: No subprocessors have access to raw customer prompts/responses. Access is limited to telemetry/infra metadata for the following vendors: CloudStore (S3), TransitNet (VPC routing), MetricsOps (aggregated telemetry). Detailed notes in attached Redwood_Subprocessors.csv.

- DPA redlines: Marcus has initiated the DocuSign envelope. For efficiency, please upload your mark-up to the DocuSign envelope so we can track changes; if you prefer, email the redline PDF and we'll route to Legal.

I'll PM Marcus if we need to change remit details. Otherwise, once DPA is signed please confirm and we'll accept the PO and move contract -> billing.

Cheers,

Priyom Das
Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
